<cite ref="N00591">same</cite>. Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ top <he>נטשנה דלא תימות גבן נטשת</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. p. 42), read: <he>נַטְּשׁוּנָהּ נטשונה …</he> let her go, that she may not die while with us; they did let her go (ed. <he>אפקונה</he>).
